item.title: Alien Dimension Add-On
item.creator: Skilendarz
item.description:
VENTURE INTO A NEW DIMENSION! Explore a procedurally generated world with endless floating islands filled with strange biomes, hostile creatures, abandoned alien ruins, and mysterious technologies.

- A real custom dimension
- Upgradable weapons & power armor
- Advanced machines and complex progression
- New challenging mobs
- Controllable terrain Terraformer
item.changelog: + New Alien Structures + New Building Blocks + Rebalanced Alien Loot Chests + The Terraformer Can Now Randomly Spawn in the Dimension + Improved Some Textures & VFX + Bug Fixes

faqEntries.heading: What is the Alien Dimension Add-On?
faqEntries.content: Alien Dimension is a massive exploration and progression Add-On that introduces the Palaran Dimension - a procedurally generated world filled with infinite floating islands, alien creatures, dangerous biomes, powerful equipment, machines, and secrets to discover. Gather resources, unlock new technology, upgrade your gear, and prepare for an epic boss fight!

faqEntries.heading: Is the Add-On suitable for solo and multiplayer?
faqEntries.content: Alien Dimension is designed for both solo and multiplayer gameplay. Explore Palaran alone at your own pace, or team up with friends to gather resources, build technology, explore dangerous areas, and take on challenging enemies together.

faqEntries.heading: Does the Add-On have a progression system, and what can I craft?
faqEntries.content: Yes! Alien Dimension features a full progression system where you gradually unlock new technologies, weapons, power armor, machines, and resources. The in-game PDA helps guide your journey and shows what you can craft next. You'll be able to discover and build 20+ machines, including the Fabricator, Rift Generator, Bio-Lab, Upgrade Station, and more, alongside advanced weaponry, resource-processing systems, and specialized equipment.

faqEntries.heading: Are there new mobs and bosses?
faqEntries.content: Yes! The Palaran Dimension is inhabited by a variety of alien creatures, each bringing new dangers to your exploration. As you progress and prepare your equipment, you'll eventually face the Alien Cyborg Boss, putting everything you've learned and built to the test.

faqEntries.heading: Is the Add-On focused only on combat?
faqEntries.content: Not at all. Alien Dimension combines exploration, resource gathering, crafting, progression, and combat. You can search for rare resources, discover new biomes, build advanced technology, hunt for loot, uncover secrets, or prepare for the most dangerous encounters. There's no single way to play.

faqEntries.heading: Will there be enough to explore?
faqEntries.content: Definitely! The Palaran Dimension features procedurally generated terrain to ensure every world is completely unique. Beyond basic survival, you can infiltrate Alien UFOs, explore mysterious structures, and gather high-tier loot. With custom blueprints, specialized upgrades, and advanced technology, there's always something new to uncover - whether it's your first playthrough or your tenth!

howToEntries.heading: Learn to Use the PDA
howToEntries.content: The PDA is your personal guide to the Alien Dimension. It contains information about the Add-On's items, machines, crafting recipes, progression, and where important resources and blueprints can be found. When you're unsure what to do next, the PDA is the first place you should look.

howToEntries.heading: Getting Started
howToEntries.content: To begin your journey, craft a Cow Mask. When disguised as a cow, a Patrol UFO might appear and attempt to abduct you. Once inside, make your way toward the Control Room and grab a Signal Locator, but don't take too long - the aliens will eventually flood the UFO with toxic gas! The Signal Locator can track down a Rift Generator hidden in the world. Once you locate it, eliminate the aliens guarding it so you can safely activate the Rift Generator and step through to enter the Palaran Dimension.

howToEntries.heading: Early Technology & Power Generation
howToEntries.content:
The Alien Workbench is the foundation of your alien technology. Use it to craft equipment and weapons from Alien Alloy, and start collecting the materials needed for more advanced machines. One of your earliest priorities should be getting better protection and tools for exploring the Dimension. 
Advanced alien technology requires Palarite Power (PE). Start with a Coal Generator and connect your machines using Palarite Cables. The Compressor is one of the first powered machines you'll need. As you explore and gather resources, you'll unlock additional machines that expand what you can craft and automate.

howToEntries.heading: Equipment Upgrades & Advanced Machinery
howToEntries.content:
The Upgrade Station allows you to improve compatible weapons and tools using Upgrade Chips. Some chips improve existing statistics, while others unlock completely new functionality. 
Blueprints are one of the keys to progression. You can discover them in Alien Loot Chests or obtain them through Alien Exchange machines, with availability depending on the biome. As your technology advances, you'll gain access to specialized machines such as the Fabricator, Bio-Lab, or Supercomputer.

howToEntries.heading: The Mothership, Alien Cyborg & Terraformer
howToEntries.content: The Emergency Radio allows you to summon the Mothership - a heavily guarded base of operations. A direct assault is extremely dangerous, so use an Alien Mask to infiltrate while disguised. At the heart of the Mothership waits the Alien Cyborg. Do not enter this boss fight unprepared - bring a Palarite Blaster, Power Armor, and plenty of supplies. The Cyborg wields a devastating Gravity Hammer capable of powerful jump attacks. Defeat the boss to unlock the Alien Terraformer, a powerful orbital megastructure capable of large-scale block manipulation.
